items.description: After the up migration, the batch_number column in stock_records is defined as nullable in the real-branch schema (information_schema.columns IS_NULLABLE = YES)
After the up migration, the serial_number column in stock_records is defined as nullable in the real-branch schema (information_schema.columns IS_NULLABLE = YES)
A row whose inventory_code is a well-formed three-segment hyphen-delimited string has batch_number equal to the second segment after the backfill step
A row whose inventory_code is a well-formed three-segment hyphen-delimited string has serial_number equal to the third segment after the backfill step
A row whose inventory_code has fewer than three hyphen-delimited segments has batch_number equal to NULL after the backfill step, with no exception raised
A row whose inventory_code has fewer than three hyphen-delimited segments has serial_number equal to NULL after the backfill step, with no exception raised
After the up migration completes, the count of rows in stock_records equals the count before the migration for the test's own seeded rows (delta is zero)
After the up migration completes, each seeded row retains its original id value
After the up migration completes, each seeded row retains its original location value
After the up migration completes, the UNIQUE constraint on (sku, location) exists on stock_records in the real-branch schema
Given any migration step fails partway, when the migration rolls back, the stock_records table is left exactly as it was before the migration started
The migration reads its database connection exclusively from the DATABASE_URL environment variable; no connection string is hardcoded in any migration file

Given a known mix of conforming and non-conforming inventory_codes, when the up migration completes its backfill, then the integrity probe reports a count of NULL batch_number/serial_number rows equal to the actual number of non-conforming rows
After the up migration completes, the inventory_code column does not exist in the stock_records schema on the real branch

After a single-step downgrade then upgrade of this migration on the real branch, the stock_records schema matches the expected post-upgrade shape (batch_number, serial_number present; inventory_code absent)
After a single-step downgrade of this migration, rows seeded before the up migration are still present in stock_records with their original id values
Given the up migration has been applied, when the down migration runs, then inventory_code is re-added and reconstructed from canonical location, batch_number, and serial_number for each row
The stock API route handler (app/routes/) does not import or reference the database session object directly — all data access flows through the service layer
The database connection in the stock API path is resolved exclusively from the DATABASE_URL environment variable; no connection string or credential is hardcoded in any layer touched by this story
fetching a stock record whose batch_number is set returns a response body that contains a batch_number field equal to that record's stored value
The stock service module (app/services/) contains no ORM or session imports — it delegates all persistence to app/repositories/ and holds no SQLAlchemy Session references
fetching a stock record whose serial_number is set returns a response body that contains a serial_number field equal to that record's stored value
The stock API boundary module (app/routes/) contains no ORM or session imports — the repository is the sole module that imports and operates the ORM session
fetching a stock record whose batch_number is NULL returns a response body where batch_number is explicitly null rather than omitted
fetching a stock record whose serial_number is NULL returns a response body where serial_number is explicitly null rather than omitted
The stock endpoint returns a JSON response (Content-Type application/json) containing data fields — it does not return server-rendered HTML
fetching any stock record after the tracking-code split returns a response body that does not contain an inventory_code field
The stock-api boundary module (app/routes/) does not import SQLAlchemy Session or any ORM session object — all data reads in the display path flow through the service layer
The stock-service module (app/services/) contains no SQLAlchemy Session or ORM imports — it delegates all persistence reads to app/repositories/ and holds no session references
The database connection URL used by the stock display path is resolved exclusively from the DATABASE_URL environment variable — no connection string is hardcoded in any module touched by this story
fetching the stock list returns a response with Content-Type application/json and a JSON body — the boundary does not return server-rendered HTML
Given a stock record seeded with a uuid-suffixed sku and batch_number 'B001', when GET /api/stock returns the list, then the response contains a row with batch_number field equal to 'B001'
Given a stock record seeded with a uuid-suffixed sku and serial_number 'S001', when GET /api/stock returns the list, then the response contains a row with serial_number field equal to 'S001'
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at /stock with a mocked API response containing batch_number shows a list row with a data-testid='batch-number' element displaying the batch_number value
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at /stock with a mocked API response containing serial_number shows a list row with a data-testid='serial-number' element displaying the serial_number value
Given a POST /api/stock request with separate batch_number and serial_number fields using a uuid-suffixed sku, the record is persisted with the submitted batch_number value
Given a POST /api/stock request with separate batch_number and serial_number fields using a uuid-suffixed sku, the record is persisted with the submitted serial_number value
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at /stock/new shows a form with a data-testid='batch-number-input' labeled input field for batch_number
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at /stock/new shows a form with a data-testid='serial-number-input' labeled input field for serial_number
Given a stock record seeded with a uuid-suffixed sku and batch_number NULL, when GET /api/stock returns the list, then the response contains a row where batch_number is explicitly null
Given a stock record seeded with a uuid-suffixed sku and serial_number NULL, when GET /api/stock returns the list, then the response contains a row where serial_number is explicitly null

rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at /stock with a mocked API response where batch_number is null shows a data-testid='batch-number' element with a 'not tracked' indicator rather than a blank or reconstructed value

rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at /stock with a mocked API response where serial_number is null shows a data-testid='serial-number' element with a 'not tracked' indicator rather than a blank or reconstructed value
Given any stock record in the system, when GET /api/stock returns the list, then no record in the response contains an inventory_code field
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at /stock with a mocked API response shows no element with text or data-testid referencing inventory_code in the list view
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at /stock/new shows no element with text or data-testid referencing inventory_code in the form view
